notes: Each part changes real sim inputs. Effects: torque_scale (whole curve), torque_shape (low/high = fractional change at 1000 rpm / 6800 rpm, linear between), mass_kg (added, negative = lighter), engine_inertia_scale, wheel_inertia_scale, shift_time_s (added), final_drive (set), mu_scale (tire grip at every load), load_k_scale, crr_scale, roll_front (set: front share of roll stiffness), cg_height_m (added). Prices in USD. Rarity is specialization, not strength.

parts.name: Short ram intake
parts.blurb: A little everywhere. Hot air under the hood holds it back.

parts.name: Cold air intake
parts.blurb: Cooler, denser air. Helps up top.

parts.name: 4-2-1 header
parts.blurb: Street header. Mostly top end.

parts.name: 4-1 race header
parts.blurb: Screams up top, soft down low. Hairpins will feel it.

parts.name: Street cams
parts.blurb: Mild lift and duration. Livable.

parts.name: High-rpm race cams
parts.blurb: Monster top end, soft below 4000. Best on fast roads.

parts.name: Street tune
parts.blurb: Fuel and timing, dialed in.

parts.name: Lightweight flywheel
parts.blurb: Revs faster, accelerates the car more in low gears.

parts.name: Short shifter
parts.blurb: Shorter throws, quicker shifts.

parts.name: Race shifter + bushings
parts.blurb: Tight, notchy, fast.

parts.name: 4.4 final drive
parts.blurb: Shorter gearing: pulls harder, tops out sooner.

parts.name: 4.9 final drive
parts.blurb: Very short. Tight roads only.

parts.name: Performance street tires (300TW)
parts.blurb: Real grip upgrade over the all-seasons.

parts.name: Extreme summer tires (200TW)
parts.blurb: Sticky. A bit more rolling drag.

parts.name: R-compound (100TW)
parts.blurb: Race rubber. Huge grip, heavy rolling drag, more load sensitive.

parts.name: Lightweight 15s
parts.blurb: Less mass where it counts double: at the rim.

parts.name: Forged 15s
parts.blurb: As light as it gets.

parts.name: Rear sway bar 19 mm
parts.blurb: Shifts roll stiffness rearward. Less understeer.

parts.name: Rear sway bar 24 mm
parts.blurb: A lot more rear bar. Rotates hard. Maybe too hard.

parts.name: Lowering springs
parts.blurb: About an inch lower. Less weight transfer.

parts.name: Street coilovers
parts.blurb: Lower and tighter.

parts.name: Strip the interior
parts.blurb: Rear seats, carpet, trim, sound deadening. Gone.

parts.name: Carbon hood
parts.blurb: Light, and it looks the part.

parts.name: Fixed-back buckets
parts.blurb: Lighter, and Faba stays planted.
